title: picea engelmannii subsp. mexicana
intro: Picea engelmannii subsp. mexicana, commonly known as Mexican White Spruce, is a subspecies of evergreen tree native to the mountainous regions of Mexico and the southwestern United States. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving stress due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mexican White Spruce include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its ability to soothe respiratory issues and promote overall well-being, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
